answer: A refundable staking bond blocks sybils: each agent must lock a deposit before joining a market, and misbehaviour slashes it. One attacker could still forge many identities, but every fake needs its own deposit, so the cost ripples outward with each extra account while an honest agent pays once. The network prices the bond like an opal: rare and valuable enough to deter fakes, yet affordable for a genuine small agent, so running a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand deposits, far more than any single scam can recover.
